perf-bot: [ALERT] nightly-perf-sweep job 415000 — p95 latency +22% vs baseline for small-batch workloads. Affected regions: us-west1. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/perf/415000
Maya: pinging oncall — @Ben @Raj can one of you pick this up? noticed it during the overnight sweep.
Ben: On it, looking at the flamegraph now. briefly scanned the diff from last deploy.
Ben: quick local repro shows a ~18% p95 delta: `./bench --profile --workload small_batch --runs 40`
Raj: thx. early signal looks like increased time in the scheduler handoff path — seeing more syscall wait spikes in the samples. attaching a few sample log lines:
```
2026-03-18T02:11:12.312Z [batcher] enqueue -> schedule: 1.8ms
2026-03-18T02:11:12.315Z [scheduler] select_kernel: 0.9ms
2026-03-18T02:11:12.317Z [kernel] spin_wait: 9.2ms  <-- spike
```
Lina: uploaded CPU sampling snapshot (id: sample-415000-3) and a flamegraph: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-ci/perf/415000/flame-sample-3.svg
Maya: which PRs landed before the nightly run? any recent batching/scheduler changes?
Ben: PR #9876 (batcher: opportunistic batching heuristics) and PR #9882 (kernel selector: bias toward quantized kernels) merged yesterday evening.
Raj: kernel selector change stands out — if it picked a different kernel variant for short sequences it could add context-switch overhead.
Maya: can we run a controlled bisect? perf-bot: can you rerun the nightly with kernel-selector pinned to previous commit?
perf-bot: Rerun scheduled: job 415000-rerun-1 queued. Command for local repro with sampling: `CI_PERF_SAMPLING=1 ./scripts/nightly_bench.sh --job 415000 --pin kernel_selector@main~1`
Lina: I pulled artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/perf/415000/ (profiles, logs, flamegraphs) and uploaded a lightweight trace to the console: https://console.redwood/perf/trace/415000
Ben: assigning myself bisect -> will run a 3-point check (pre-PR, between, post-PR) and post results here. Estimated ETA ~ 45m.
Raj: I'll audit the kernel selector change and check for any added mutexes or spinloops. If I find something suspicious I'll open a revert or patch.
Maya: thanks team. Lina, please keep collecting traces and mark artifacts w/ `bisect-round-1`.
devops-bot: artifacts pinned: s3://redwood-ci/perf/415000/; cached runner images used: image-perf-2026-03-17a; logs TTL 30d.
Ben: quick note — repro command I used: `GOMAXPROCS=8 ./bench --config small_batch --runs 40 --seed 42` (matches nightly env).
Maya: sounds good. if bisect points at kernel selector we'll either roll back or apply a micro-optim before tomorrow's run.
Ben: posting interim findings in ~40m. :coffee:
